errors.summary: A group of people throw stones at a line of police officers holding shields.
Several people smash the windows of a parked bus while a crowd shouts.
People in a crowd hurl bottles and bricks across the road at another group.
A man holds a knife and points it at a shopkeeper behind the counter.
A person raises a long iron rod above his head and moves towards another man.
A man takes out a pistol from his waistband and aims it at the door.
Flames and thick black smoke rise from a parked car on the roadside.
A shop front is on fire and smoke fills the street.
A small fire burns in a dustbin next to the wall, with smoke drifting up.
Two police officers hold a man by the arms and put handcuffs on him.
An officer escorts a handcuffed man to a police van and opens the door.
Officers pin a man to the ground and restrain his hands behind his back.
A man runs fast down the street and an officer sprints after him.
A motorcycle speeds away and a police jeep follows it closely through traffic.
One person runs between the stalls while two others run after him shouting.
An elderly man collapses on the platform and lies still on the ground.
A person is lying motionless on the pavement while people walk past.
A car hits a scooter at the junction and the rider falls onto the road.
Two cars collide head-on and one of them spins across the lane.
A truck overturns on the highway and its load spills onto the road.
A man on a bike snatches a woman's chain and rides away quickly.
A person grabs a bag from a parked scooter and runs off.
Someone lifts a phone from a table at the stall and walks away fast.
A man sprays paint on the wall of the government office at night.
A person kicks and breaks the glass of a bus shelter, alone.
A young man smashes the side mirror of a parked car with a stick, then walks off.
The crowd at the temple gate suddenly runs in all directions and people fall.
The station entrance is packed so tightly that people are being crushed against the barrier.
People push and surge towards a narrow exit and several are pressed against the railing.
Two people walk through the office entrance one right behind the other on a single card swipe.
A man follows closely behind an employee through the security door before it closes.
Three people pass the turnstile together, the second and third right behind the first.
A backpack is left alone near the pillar for a long time after its owner walks away.
A man stands in the same corner of the parking lot for twenty minutes, looking around.
A suitcase stays unattended on the platform bench while no one is near it.
A man keeps following a woman along the footpath and blocks her way when she tries to step aside.
On the crowded bus a man repeatedly touches a woman who pushes his hand away and moves.
Two youths on a scooter circle a girl walking alone, shouting at her as she hurries away.
